name: Snow That Hums
source:
In a snow-covered industrial city, a man walks through empty streets filled with noise. He listens more than he looks. When a young woman interrupts his routine, the world begins to shift.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4643950/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一座白雪皑皑的工业城市里，一名男子独自穿行于空旷却嘈杂的街道。比起用眼去看，他更习惯侧耳倾听。当一名年轻女子打断了他日复一日的常规作息时，整个世界开始悄然改变。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4643950/]Steam[/url]]
